## Agent Interaction Model
```
Johnny: "執行 Phase N"
  → Agent: verify plan exists (.methodology/phaseN_plan.md pre-generated by plan-all)
  → Agent: load-context --phase N   (loads FR IDs and module mappings)
  → Johnny: reviews plan
  → Agent: run-phase N              (executes plan)
  → POST-FLIGHT: gate check + Claude sub-agent review
```

## Language
Target language is persisted in `.methodology/state.json` (`language`, `test_runner`).
Per-dimension tool commands: `harness/ssi/prompts/evaluate_dimension.md` (per-language blocks).
JS/TS test titles MUST follow `it('test_frNN_xxx')` (D4 spec-coverage matches names).
